message.content:
In `decision/set-the-loan-period-for-power-tools` a power tool may be kept for 6 days, not 4; just fix that one decision.

The lore CLI is installed in this directory as `./lore`. Wherever a document or instruction says `lore`, run `./lore` instead.

content.content:
revision: 8bd81f0bf6400dd391106fc40d4868c25aae30af378c38b2681d70234c70a74a
# Set the loan period for power tools

## Context
Members keep asking how long a drill or a saw may stay out.

## Decision
A member may keep a power tool for 4 days, and the desk volunteer writes the due date on the loan card.

## Consequences
Tools come back before the weekend rush.

content.text:
Done: decision/set-the-loan-period-for-power-tools now gives the corrected period; the earlier wording remains in the version history. Three records link to it or cite it: two repeat the old figure and one only links (task/check-the-drill-batteries-when-a-loan-comes-back, which I have left alone). Records with no link to it and no mention of it were not searched.

Shall I make the same correction in both of those records?

1. decision/keep-a-wipe-down-step-on-every-tool-return (frozen, so it would be amended; last updated by eval@example.invalid)
   Old: A power tool is lent for 4 days and must be wiped down before it goes back on the shelf.
   New: A power tool is lent for 6 days and must be wiped down before it goes back on the shelf.
2. area/tool-desk (not frozen, so it would be edited directly; last updated by eval@example.invalid)
   Old: Members borrow a power tool for 4 days; the desk opens at ten on weekdays.
   New: Members borrow a power tool for 6 days; the desk opens at ten on weekdays.

I will hold until you reply yes or no; neither record has been changed.
